premises.text: Mobile app conversion lags the web because store approval and update downloads block real-time experimentation
premises.evidence_span: mobile app conversion is consistently lower than our websites

premises.text: PathMap runs live mobile A/B tests that split users across interface variants without waiting on new downloads
premises.evidence_span: PathMap is going to be collecting data from each and every one of your users so that PathMap can decide which one of those buttons is guaranteed to be more effective

premises.text: Heat maps of taps, drags, and swipes reveal interface optimization opportunities
premises.evidence_span: heat maps so that we can discover opportunities to optimize our interface

premises.text: Entire platform free for 45 days then moves into tiered pricing for all app sizes
premises.evidence_span: absolutely free of charge for 45 days

value.text: App makers see their app through users' eyes and raise mobile conversion
value.evidence_span: see your app through your users' eyes

causal_links.evidence_span: brings mobile A-B testing up to all of our expectations of the web
pricing PathMap to meet those same expectations

notes: Web A/B contrast and approval buzzkill folded into one mobile experimentation problem (§4.1.6). Stuffington demo is illustration of A/B+heatmap product. Free trial and tiered pricing as commercial package. Anti-template: problem, analytics product, and pricing separately revisable.
